source_text.body:
Order a pizza to your house with an agent
A writer asked ChatGPT Agent to find a well-rated local pizza place and order; it clicked through pop-ups, couldn't reach the order section, and gave up.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The writer started ChatGPT Agent with a prompt to order a pizza to their address and ask for confirmation before paying. The agent picked Domino's, chose pizzas at random, and fought with the basket link. The writer then tried a best-rated search and a specific hard-to-navigate restaurant. The agent handed control back at the payment step.
How it went
Every variation eventually reached checkout, but it took 15-20 minutes for the simple order, and 10-15 minutes just to find the specific restaurant. Pop-ups, cookie banners, and basket loops slowed it. The summary's claim that it gave up is not accurate.
Worth knowing
Name the pizza you want in the prompt. The agent picked and removed items at random, added unneeded wings, and defaulted to big chains.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Find a well-rated [cuisine, e.g. pizza] place near [my address or neighborhood] that is open now and delivers. Open its ordering page and build an order for [items and quantities]. If a pop-up or page blocks you from reaching the menu, tell me where you got stuck instead of looping. Stop before payment and show me the restaurant, items, delivery fee, and total so I can approve.
Original source: https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/chatgpt/articles/asked-chatgpt-agent-order-pizza-050300611.html
